method_and_limits: Only the two permitted new input files were read for this subtask. No earlier observer explanations, project classifications, quotes, or analysis code were consulted.
The same agent previously performed a separate image geometry task. This text task used only the new packet as evidence and did not connect those images to the text.

Complete head lexeme means the lexical title word, excluding planetary symbols and terminal punctuation. A longer inflected word or a differently spelled word is not reported as that complete lexical form. No exact-match rate or aggregate count was calculated.

Body self-reference is distinguished from other named people, comparisons, ingredients, and discourse objects. Only-generic describes references to the section subject, not absence of all names anywhere in the paragraph.

No spelling was corrected, no missing characters supplied, and no line-end glyph was silently removed in evidence. Excerpts are literal contiguous slices of original XML with offsets. XML head serialization is supplied for orientation, while excerpt and section hashes preserve input traceability.

All findings are restricted to the supplied readable material. A few short positive excerpts illustrate each observation; the no-complete-word findings come from reading each full section, not from treating those excerpts as exhaustive proof.

Fields are nonexclusive: variant forms, explicit alternate naming, and generic reference may coexist. Ambiguous spelling causes and split-letter interpretation remain unknown. Historical naming stories are attributed to the source and not independently validated.
